Remember, this scholarship could be your gateway to an unparalleled learning experience and a personal mentorship from me!
For two decades, India’s top JEE rankers have chased dreams far beyond the IIT gates. I spoke with six JEE toppers, including two AIR 1s, to discover where their hard work led them. Spoiler: Most ended up abroad, working at top global tech companies or pursuing cutting-edge research. But what does this mean for India? Are we just creating talent for the world? Let's find out in this video.
